POL-SHIP-002:1.0.title: Shipping Fee Schedule and Shipping Support Policy (Freeship TikiPRO)
POL-SHIP-002:1.0.content: Shipping fees on Tiki are calculated automatically based on distance and parcel weight: Intra-city orders carry a base fee of 18,000 VND to 25,000 VND. Inter-provincial orders range from 35,000 VND to 55,000 VND. Customers with TikiPRO memberships or orders meeting the minimum value of 149,000 VND can apply Freeship discount vouchers for up to 30,000 VND - 70,000 VND in shipping discounts. The final shipping fee is displayed transparently on the checkout page.

POL-SHIP-001:1.0.title: Estimated Delivery Timelines and Tiki Shipping Service Packages
POL-SHIP-001:1.0.content: Estimated delivery times on Tiki are categorized by service package: TikiNOW Express delivers within 2 hours in inner districts of Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Da Nang. Fast Delivery delivers within 1-2 business days across major urban centers. Standard Delivery takes 3-5 business days for inter-provincial orders or rural districts. During severe weather or peak holiday seasons, delivery may be extended by 1-2 additional days.

POL-SHIP-004:1.0.title: Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
POL-SHIP-004:1.0.content: In the event a Tiki order exceeds its estimated delivery date without arrival, or if a courier marks an order as 'Successfully Delivered' when the customer has not received the parcel, the customer must contact Tiki Customer Support within 24-48 hours via hotline 1900 6035. Tiki's dispatch team will verify courier GPS logs, coordinate with the delivery hub, and resolve the complaint. If an order is lost, Tiki will dispatch a replacement or issue a 100% refund.

POL-RET-003:2.0.title: Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
POL-RET-003:2.0.content: Product categories that do not support returns due to change of mind or personal preference include: Underwear, swimwear, cosmetics and chemicals with unsealed protective packaging, Tiki Ngon fresh groceries, dietary supplements, mobile top-up scratch cards, electronic service vouchers, and clearance outlet items marked as non-returnable. These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

POL-RET-001:2.0.title: Tiki Standard Product Return and Exchange Policy and Conditions
POL-RET-001:2.0.content: Customers may request an exchange or return within 30 days (for products directly distributed by Tiki Trading) or within 7 days (for products from marketplace partner sellers on Tiki) from the date of successful delivery. Returned products must have intact security seals, complete original packaging, accessories, invoices, and included promotional gifts, and show no signs of usage or laundering.

POL-REFUND-001:1.0.title: Safe Refund Reconciliation Rules and Principles on Tiki
POL-REFUND-001:1.0.content: Refund requests are only processed once an order has been successfully canceled prior to dispatch, or after the Tiki warehouse receives and inspects the returned product to standard. All refund decisions must undergo reconciliation by authorized customer service personnel; AI is prohibited from autonomously approving monetary transactions. Original shipping fees are non-refundable if the return reason is based on personal preference.

POL-REFUND-002:2.0.title: Refund Receipt Timeline by Payment Method on Tiki
POL-REFUND-002:2.0.content: The timeline for receiving a refund on Tiki depends on the original payment method: For Tiki Coins Wallet, refunds are credited within 24 hours. For linked e-wallets (MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay, Viettel Money), funds are returned to the wallet within 1-2 business days. For domestic Napas ATM cards, the timeline is 3-5 business days. For international credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB), issuing banks process within 7-15 business days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays).

POL-REFUND-007:1.0.title: Checking Refund History and Order Status on Tiki
POL-REFUND-007:1.0.content: Customers can monitor refund progress by accessing 'Account Details' > 'Return & Refund Management'. Refund statuses include: 'Reconciliation Processing' (under customer support review), 'Transferred to Bank' (funds dispatched from Tiki, awaiting bank credit), and 'Refund Succeeded' along with the bank's transaction tracing reference code.

POL-ORD-002:1.0.title: Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
POL-ORD-002:1.0.content: Customers can click 'Cancel Order' directly on the Tiki app if the order is in 'Processing' or 'Awaiting Packing' status and has not yet been handed over to the shipping carrier.
